items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He says, 'How you doin', Salvatore, how you doin', Dominick' -- all that. He went right along with them. ... They loved him.

ctx.x: Yeah, right on time. Then we went in, went in the back, and there in the back, man, chicks in there, fast chicks, and them cats are shootin' dice like crazy -- the whole scene. Then we go in, and they go, "Hey, Billy, daddy. Hey, Billy the Dag. Yeah, Bill, how you doin', Billy?" He says, "How you doin', Salvatore, how you doin', Dominick" -- all that. He went right along with them. We'd go in the back, and the man's saying, "Give-a Bill-a drink. Get him..." I don't know what... He had something with them people.…
